citations.quote: Title search shows a half interest in a residential dwelling at Marlow Creek, outside Darwin.
A half interest in another dwelling is declared.
The dwelling is unsafe to occupy because the entrance and wet areas cannot be used with the applicant's current mobility needs.
A wheelchair cannot pass into the bathing area as it stands.
The applicant now uses a wheelchair and needs step-free access to sleeping and bathing areas.
Delay in accessible accommodation would increase the risk of injury during transfers.
Please refer this unusual property and medical situation to a manager for a documented discretionary decision.
Oren asks a manager to consider the property interest alongside the medical and access reports and to provide the decision in writing.
No authorised discretionary decision is attached.
